item.title: Workout reminders keep the right routine
item.summary: Murph now closes a tracked workout when you log its final planned set, so the next reminder can use the right saved routine without a separate finish message.
item.details: This works in an ordinary private-chat reply without requiring the iMessage Reply feature. If an older workout is already still open, Murph asks for its end time or total duration instead of guessing, and explicit corrections stay attached to that workout.
